subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should unmentioned WhatsApp automatic group turns suppress typing now as a narrow mitigation, or should this wait for the broader visible-delivery boundary in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477?
rationale: Both paths address false typing for silent/background WhatsApp group runs, but they make different UX and API-surface tradeoffs that automation cannot choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebase Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Refresh this PR onto current main and keep the focused suppressTyping change if maintainers accept that rare proactive unmentioned visible replies may arrive without a typing indicator.

options.title: Prefer Visible-Delivery Boundary
options.body: Pause this PR and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 the canonical path if maintainers want typing to start only at the send boundary despite the larger API/runtime surface.

options.title: Keep Current Automatic Typing
options.body: Reject the broader suppression behavior if maintainers prefer automatic unmentioned group replies to keep their typing indicator even with possible false positives on silent runs.

recommendation.title: Rebase Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR onto current main and keep the focused suppressTyping change if maintainers accept that rare proactive unmentioned visible replies may arrive without a typing indicator.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery PR and has recent main-branch history in the WhatsApp inbound-dispatch path.
